knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The check is a separate final step after cleaning, so it looks at the finished result.
A sharp is never picked up by hand. The person stops, does not touch it, and follows the sharps and incident procedure.
An uncleared mark is recorded and reported. Hiding it or using an unapproved product is not acceptable.

practicalCriteria: Runs the bathroom check in the set order, from the doorway first, with the light on, as observed.
Checks glass and tiles at an angle, and feels edges for residue with a clean cloth.
Records each uncleared mark on the checklist and reports it, without covering it.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Bathroom checklist with each zone ticked
stopWorkCriteria: Sharp or biological material handled by hand
Electrical appliance opened or repaired by a person without the relevant licence
